verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships Loop, an in-product AI agent that lets users investigate logs in natural language instead of writing queries. Loop can also build scorers, datasets and dashboards, and runs Patterns on a schedule. Its official MCP server separately lets users run evals, query logs and author prompts and scorers through natural-language agents such as Claude Code and Cursor. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Loop's natural-language operation, and in-depth documentation of how far Loop reaches beyond data investigation and artifact creation (for example, project or admin operations).
